name: New engine
about: Propose or announce a synth, drum engine or effect
title: "engine: <name>"

---

**What it is** (one paragraph: the sound, the idea behind it)

**Kind and tracks:** synth (bass/lead/arp/chord) / drum (kick/snare/perc/sample) / effect (FX1/FX2)

**P1 and P2** would control:

**Memory:** expected size (5 KB, 10 KB or 50 KB class) and why; tables or buffers it needs

**DSP sources:** your own, or ported from (name, link, licence; MIT/BSD/ISC/public domain only)

**State:** idea / prototype in the simulator / pull request open

See `guides/submit-an-engine.md` for the path from here to the website.
